tip: Plural reflexive pronouns can mean each other, not just oneself: ci chiamiamo means we call each other.
Negative commands to one person (tu) use non plus the infinitive: non scrivere means don't write.
With reflexive verbs and body parts, Italian uses the article, not a possessive: si lava le mani = washes his hands.
Singular family members drop the article after a possessive: mia madre, not la mia madre.
Weather uses fare, not essere: fa freddo means it is cold, literally it makes cold.
